CustomField.description: This formula fields indicate whether you can create/update account team record.(Used in Trigger)
CustomField.formula: IF( OR(AND($Profile.Name == 'System Administrator', Team_Member__r.Employee_Code__c != $Label.CEO_Employee_Code) , AND(($Profile.Name == 'Admin_Tur' || $Profile.Name == 'Turkey Sales'), TEXT(Team_Member__r.User_Type__c) == TEXT(CreatedBy.User_Type__c), Team_Member__r.Employee_Code__c != $Label.CEO_Employee_Code) ) , True, If((Account__r.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Distributor' || Account__r.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Doctor_D' || Account__r.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Distributor_T' || Account__r.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Doctor_T' ) && ( TEXT(Team_Member__r.User_Type__c) == TEXT(CreatedBy.User_Type__c) && Team_Member__r.ManagerId == CreatedById && Team_Member__r.Employee_Code__c != $Label.CEO_Employee_Code ), True, IF((Account__r.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Ophthalmic_Vision' || Account__r.RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Ortho_Dermal' ) && ( TEXT(Team_Member__r.User_Type__c) == TEXT(CreatedBy.User_Type__c) && Team_Member__r.Employee_Code__c != $Label.CEO_Employee_Code ), True, False ) ))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This formula fields indicate whether you can create/update account team record.
CustomField.label: Allow Creation
